cusp_glue.method: as the tau glue, but the defect comes from the Coulomb cusp only: tau = s * [K u_c - T_c u_c], u_c = r e^{-lam r} (lam = 2 m_kin Z alpha), s fixed by the Kato law u''(0+) = -2 m_kin Z alpha u'(0) with u'(0) from the inner zig-zag solution (linear fit of u/r on r in [0.5, 4] lambda_C); no window

centre.what: nucleus on a site (centre of a cell): origin = (a/2, a/2, a/2); the site at r = 0 gets the cube average of -Z alpha/r, -(3 ln(2+sqrt3) - pi/2) Z alpha / a = -2.38008 Z alpha/a (hand-made: debt)

G1b.what: cusp glue: Z = 1 1s moves by <= 0.02 % over J0 = 3..6 (SEEN in development)

G2b.what: cusp glue: Z = 1 2s and He+ 1s move by <= 0.02 % over J0 = 3..6 and are within 0.1 % of Dirac; Z = 1 1s within 0.1 %

V1.what: valley budget (bare scans a = 0.4, 0.3, 0.24, 0.2): error of the 1s centroid = error of the nucleus-blind pair U + valley part (centroid - U). Exam: at every a the valley part is >= 50 % of |centroid error| (the multiplet, not the bulk, is the main 1s error)

V2.what: the -11.6 %: the ZIGZAG A1 extrapolation (quadratic in a^2 through a = 0.4, 0.3, 0.24) applied to U alone is within 1 % of Dirac (the valley part is what spoiled it)

V3.what: valley split below threshold with the learned nucleus: max - min of the 1s lines (weight >= 0.05) <= 0.002 mc^2 at every learned a (0.5 ... 0.2)

CN1.what: centre nucleus: the valley split (max - min of 1s lines, weight >= 0.05) at a = 0.3 is smaller than with the corner nucleus, in every colour

CN2.what: centre nucleus: the 4 colours are no longer equivalent (line positions differ by > 1e-4 between the colour holding the nucleus and the others)
